command:
set -euo pipefail
python -m pip install --no-cache-dir "$DGPU_WHEEL_URL#sha256=$DGPU_WHEEL_SHA256" diffusers==0.36.0 transformers==4.57.6 accelerate==1.12.0 safetensors==0.7.0 huggingface-hub==0.36.2
python - /models/sdxl-base-1.0-fp16-76d28af <<'LOCK'
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from gpu_orchestrator_workloads.model_packs import install_hf_pack

install_hf_pack(
    {
        "format": "huggingface",
        "model_pack": "sdxl-base-1.0-fp16-76d28af",
        "model_id": "stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0",
        "revision": "76d28af79639c28a79fa5c6c6468febd3490a37e",
        "allow_patterns": [
            "model_index.json",
            "scheduler/scheduler_config.json",
            "text_encoder/config.json",
            "text_encoder/model.fp16.safetensors",
            "text_encoder_2/config.json",
            "text_encoder_2/model.fp16.safetensors",
            "tokenizer/merges.txt",
            "tokenizer/special_tokens_map.json",
            "tokenizer/tokenizer_config.json",
            "tokenizer/vocab.json",
            "tokenizer_2/merges.txt",
            "tokenizer_2/special_tokens_map.json",
            "tokenizer_2/tokenizer_config.json",
            "tokenizer_2/vocab.json",
            "unet/config.json",
            "unet/diffusion_pytorch_model.fp16.safetensors",
            "vae/config.json",
            "vae/diffusion_pytorch_model.fp16.safetensors",
        ],
    },
    Path(sys.argv[1]),
)
LOCK
exec dgpu agent --endpoint "$DGPU_ENDPOINT" --agent-id "$DGPU_AGENT_ID" --provider salad --provider-resource-id "$DGPU_PROVIDER_RESOURCE_ID" --capability image-generate --model-pack sdxl-base-1.0-fp16-76d28af --label pool=image-standard --workdir /work --heartbeat-seconds 15 --lease-seconds 120

readme:
# Distributed GPU SDXL worker

Ephemeral one-GPU worker with a scoped queue identity and no storage or
provider credentials. The command installs the SHA-256-pinned wheel
(`#sha256=` fragment from `DGPU_WHEEL_SHA256`), the pinned Diffusers runtime,
then provisions the route's reviewed SDXL fp16 pack into
`/models/sdxl-base-1.0-fp16-76d28af` with `install_hf_pack` (immutable
revision, per-file digest verification) before the agent advertises the
capability and pack. This template has not been exercised against a paid
provider deployment.
